stem: Which conclusion is shared by BOTH theories to explain cell complexity?

options.label: A
options.text: Membrane-bound organelles like the Golgi body are less complex than mitochondria.

options.label: B
options.text: Cells became less complex by joining together with other cells.

options.label: C
options.text: Mitochondria developed before chloroplasts in complex eukaryotic cells.

options.label: D
options.text: Complex eukaryotic cells developed from simpler prokaryotic cells.

visual_elements: Table titled 'Cell Complexity Theories' comparing 'Endosymbiotic Theory' and 'Autogenous Theory'
